en.activityLifecycleHint: Experts are durable subagents: idle and ready nodes can both be woken again — there is no "finished" state.
en.empty: No round-table meeting in this workspace yet
en.emptyHint: Go back to chat and say "start a round-table meeting to discuss…" — the captain will assemble a team of experts right here. Past meetings stay in this tab and can be switched back to anytime.
en.feedbackAskNotePlaceholder: What was the biggest pain point? (optional)
en.feedbackAskSubmitted: Thanks! Manage or clear feedback anytime under Settings → RoundTable → User feedback.
en.feedbackAskTitle: Was this meeting useful? (1 tap, anonymous, disable in settings)
en.feedbackEnabled: Ask for lightweight feedback when a meeting ends
en.feedbackEnabledHint: On: shows one 1-tap usefulness question after a meeting/review closes; turn it off here anytime.
en.feedbackPrivacyNote: Privacy: only the collaboration mode, expert provider/model, round/token usage, timestamp and an optional one-line note are recorded — never conversation content. Stored in the workspace-level feedback.jsonl (consider .gitignore); can be wiped with one click.
en.fetchFailed: Failed to fetch meeting state, retrying…
en.kbBrowseHint: Browse-only: clicking a file does nothing; the captain reads and relays content to experts when needed.
en.kbContentChanged: I have changed some knowledge-base content
en.kbEmpty: No files in this folder yet
en.kbLoadHint: Enter a path and save to see the file list here
en.kbPathPlaceholder: A folder on this computer (relative paths resolve against the workspace)
en.kbSaved: Knowledge-base path saved; change recorded for the captain
en.kbSaveFailed: Failed to save the knowledge-base path
en.legendEgalitarian: Expert ↔ expert: direct debate (auto-muted once the budget runs out)
en.legendHide: Hide the legend (turn it back on in settings)
en.legendOrchestrated: Captain → expert: dispatched one by one; contributions → gateway
en.legendPorts: Drag a dot on a node rim to wire an edge; right-click an edge to redirect or delete it
en.legendRedteam: Expert → plan: flaws only, no alternative proposals
en.legendSynthetic: Dashed = skeleton channels added by the system, not real traffic
en.manageAddedSoon: Recorded: expert {name} will join next round
en.manageEffectiveHint: Changes take effect when the captain acts in the next round (the UI marks pending states right away).
en.manageNoExperts: No experts yet — add one with the form below
en.managePendingAddRole: New expert · waiting for the captain
en.managePendingNote: The actions below are recorded; the captain executes them one by one next round. Failed actions stay recorded.
en.managePresetEmpty: No presets yet — create one under Settings → RoundTable → Role presets.
en.manageRemoveConfirm: Remove expert "{name}"? The meeting state updates when the captain executes it next round.
en.manageRemovedSoon: Recorded: expert {name} will be removed next round
en.manageSquadAdded: Queued {count} expert(s); the captain adds them next round
en.meetingDeleteConfirm: Delete meeting "{name}"? This cannot be undone (the meeting files will be permanently removed).
en.renderFailed: Panel failed to render (plugin UI error)
en.renderFailedHint: The error above is the cause. Please report it with the steps you took; switching to another tab still works, and the console (F12) holds the full stack.
en.reviewExportHint: To export the full review record (Markdown), ask the captain to export it in the conversation.
en.reviewHint: Click "Support" to confirm a real flaw — it feeds the next plan revision.
en.reviewImpactOk: Endorsed flaws are recorded; revise the plan accordingly.
en.reviewImpactThresholdHint: Several flaws were endorsed — consider renegotiating the plan before revising.
en.reviewRejectedToast: Rejected after review; it will not feed the plan revision
en.reviewRejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. this flaw is based on a misunderstanding; the plan already covers it…
en.reviewRejectReasonPrompt: Rejecting requires a reason (required, kept in the review record):
en.reviewRejectReasonRequired: Please enter a reject reason before confirming
en.reviewSupportedToast: Endorsed as a real flaw; it will feed the plan revision
en.settingsDefaultModeHint: Orchestrated: the captain relays everything. Egalitarian: experts debate each other directly and the budget mutes the meeting when exceeded (a warning asks for safety limits).
en.settingsEgalitarianWarning: Egalitarian selected: experts talk to each other directly with no captain relay — set generous round/token caps; exceeding them mutes the meeting.
en.settingsExpertMaxOpinionsHint: Opinion count cap per round (prompt constraint); 0 = unlimited.
en.settingsExpertMaxTokensHint: max_tokens per expert model request; 0 = unlimited (provider default).
en.settingsLegendHint: The mode legend in the canvas top-left corner. Hide it to keep the canvas clean; toggle it here or with the × on the legend itself.
en.settingsPanelsHint: A lit circle shows that panel in the RoundTable tab; dimmed panels are hidden (takes effect after saving).
en.settingsPresetInvalid: Preset name and role description are both required
en.settingsPresetLimit: Preset limit reached ({max}) — delete one first
en.settingsPresetRolePlaceholder: e.g. Attack from a security angle: exploitable risks and repro paths only
en.settingsPresetsEmpty: No presets yet. The two required fields below create the first one.
en.settingsPresetsHint: Save the roles you use often; picking one in the meeting's expert manager fills in the role text and model for you, so you stop retyping them. Presets are global preferences — editing them never changes a meeting that already exists, and no built-in role is shipped.
en.settingsShowAllHint: On: show every round-table meeting. Off: only meetings started by this conversation.
en.settingsSkillDeliveryDirectHint: Each expert loads the skill itself with the skill tool: more autonomy, but every expert reads it separately.
en.settingsSkillDeliveryRelayHint: The captain reads the skill and relays what matters: fewer tokens, predictable behaviour.
en.settingsSquadHint: A squad only answers "who joins": it stores the key, role and model of several experts. It says nothing about how the meeting runs — no nodes, no edges, no flow.
en.settingsSquadInvalid: The squad name and every member key are required
en.settingsSquadTitle: Squad presets (fill several experts at once)
en.skillsEmpty: No skill selected for this meeting
